feeds.title: Mysticum Luna Blog
feeds.description: An idea that started in Paige's University bedroom back in 2014, quickly grew to the small business it is today. Celebrating all things alternative, Mysticum Luna's focus is predominantly on Jewellery with a hint of Homewares and Clothing. Now a team of two, read our meet the team blog post to learn more!

feeds.title: Renee Ruin
feeds.description: My name is Renee and I am a writer and blogger. I am based in Australia and am really passionate about women's issues, sex and sexuality, mental health, diversity, inclusion, music, film, literature and real-life stories and authenticity. I am a writer, blogger, poet, PR, goth,digital,feminist, and a Mental Health Ambassador.

feeds.title: Attitude Clothing Blog
feeds.description: We are Attitude Clothing the UK's original online retailer of men's gothic clothing, men's alternative clothing and women's alternative clothing, alternative footwear, jewellery, accessories & gothic tops. Sign-up for our email newsletter and we'll send you regular special offers and discounts and you'll be the first to see the freshest clothing and accessory lines as soon as they drop!

feeds.title: La Carmina Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning Gothic fashion, subcultures, and female travel blog. La Carmina is a travel TV host and author who blogs about alternative, punk, Goth, clothing, hair and style, and Harajuku Japan youth underground culture. La Carmina's mission is to showcase underground and fringe subcultures in a positive light and encourage meaningful, offbeat, compassionate travel.

feeds.title: Bound in Bone
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Darcie. And I'm a bit of a goth. My style is probably somewhere between nu-goth & cosy goth. I love clothes but I am not good at spending money. I consider myself a feminist, I believe trans women are women, Black Lives Matter, climate change is real & mental health is important. My blog is for goths like me!

feeds.title: Amy Valentine
feeds.description: I'm Amy Valentine, I'm 20 years old and I'm a blogger and soon-to-be student at the London College of Fashion, from Hampshire. I fell into fashion blogging back in 2011, where I discovered the community and instantly wanted to be a part of it. I've always been interested in developing my personal style and sharing fashion inspiration with others, so it seemed like it was meant to be!

feeds.title: Too Fast Blog
feeds.description: Are you tired of scrolling blogs endlessly to find that one piece of information you're looking for? We're here to talk punk fashion, horror movies, creepy books, all the music, and basically, everything you love! Whether you're a Witch, Goth, Horror Head, or Punk, you'll find interesting, on-point articles about sh!t that entertain you.

feeds.title: Wearable Tattoo Blog
feeds.description: Wearable Tattoo is a top online alternative-goth-punk-rocker-emo-steampunk-latex-witch fashion brand offering a wide range of quality glam clothing & accessories. We talk about the love for inking a lot on our blog, but there's another ... Biometric tattoos are wearable technology that can be wired for many purposes.
